items.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Now, Wilbur, ‘Trane loved him, but I couldn’t stand to watch him.

ctx.x: Yeah, he and Wilbur Harden. Now, Wilbur, ‘Trane loved him, but I couldn’t stand to watch him. He’s a guy that you, literally, could hear him think. He would stand on the bandstand and be moving about “click, click, click, click” He would say, (scats very sparse, calculated melody).
